title: react-stereogram demo
content_html:
<Stereogram /> component demo →

Defocus your eyes (look "through" the screen) until two adjacent pattern repeats overlap — the hidden shape pops out in 3D. For images, brighter pixels come nearer — if your subject is darker than its background (most photos and logos), tick invert depth so the subject pops instead of the background. Grayscale depth maps work best; a few layers make photos much easier to fuse.

content_html_zh:
<Stereogram /> 组件演示 →

散焦您的眼睛（“透过”屏幕看）直到两个相邻图案重复重叠 — 隐藏的形状以 3D 形式弹出。 对于图像，较亮的像素会更近 - 如果您的主题比背景（大多数照片和徽标）更暗，请勾选反转深度，以便主题而不是背景突出。 灰度深度图效果最好；几层使照片更容易融合。
